system.effect:
Target: Your Psychic-Type Pokémon
Effect: While this Feature is Bound, you gain a Power Token each time the target uses a Status move or activates a non-Static Ability (Power Tokens are lost when spent, or when Combat ends). As a Standard Action during their turn, or as a Rapid Action during their turn by spending 1 AP, the user may spend any number of their Power Tokens to apply conditions to a foe or ally within X meters, where X is equal to your Type-Linked Skill Rank plus 2.

- 1 Power Token: The target loses/gains a Combat Stage in a Stat of your choice.
- 2 Power Tokens: The target loses/gains a Combat Stage in two different Stats of your choice.
- 3 Power Tokens: The target loses/gains 2 Combat Stages in a Stat of your choice.
- 4 Power Tokens: The target loses a Status Affliction, and gives it to another creature in range.
- 5 Power Tokens: The target has its Combat Stages reset to their defaults.
